purpose: Production reality gate: distinguish runnable product engines from sellable and deliverable products.
commercial_rule: No item is marked SOLD until a real deliverable, delivery path, price and owner-authorized payment path are evidenced.
pricing_rule: A 20-percent-below-market target may be used only after a current benchmark is recorded; never fabricate a market benchmark.
legal_rule: Legal products provide organization, issue spotting, evidence preparation and educational information; they do not promise court outcomes or replace a qualified lawyer or court.
education_rule: Education products may teach and assess skills, but no accreditation is claimed unless an authorized accreditation path exists.
quantum_rule: Quantum-inspired or classical simulation is not presented as real quantum hardware or quantum advantage.
